limitations: One bounded family: named inner classes capturing the enclosing instance. Existing static nested classes, ordinary inheritance, extension methods and lambdas are prerequisites.

Nongeneric ordinary outer classes and final inner classes. Captured outer identity, state access, method calls, initialization, qualified construction, source/compiled constructors, Kotlin consumers and JVM metadata are checked. Generic/chained source inner classes, secondary/default constructors, open/abstract source inner classes, enum outers, reserved capture-field collisions and local classes remain explicit unsupported boundaries. Nongeneric bound and unbound inner constructor references use ordinary closure lowering. Invalid static nested declarations within inner classes remain invalid Kotlin.

Fixed Java callers compile once against official output and execute against both outputs with full JVM verification. Relevant public ABI and decoded Kotlin metadata are compared. No unchanged whole AndroidBible file, APK/device/full-app, optimization, or complete Kotlin compatibility claim.

abi_policy.required: Public/protected declared methods, constructors, fields, signatures, generic bridges and default helpers are compared. Static synthetic access$ private-access helpers are excluded using method identity and JVM modifiers together; source methods are not excluded by name alone.
abi_policy.known_difference: Korrust retains its existing package-private synthetic lexical bridge names/visibility. Kotlin uses public final synthetic private-access helpers. Raw all-member javap output is preserved.
abi_policy.provider_replacement_scope: Each provider supplies the complete related outer and inner class set. Official generated inner classes are not mixed with candidate outer classes. No reflection-exact claim.
